description: MODEL FAMILY -> COMPATIBILITY SHIM. A shim is what a model family needs to speak a harness's wire protocol (here: Claude Code's Anthropic-compatible API through OpenRouter). It is independent of which capability class a model serves: the same family gets the same shim whether it is the code-low or the code-high model. Matched by glob against the canonical model id, first match wins; a model with no matching family gets no shim. Only families with a live-tested shim belong here — do not add speculative entries.

shims.note: Z.ai GLM through OpenRouter needs the glm-claude-compat preset for Claude Code tool calling. The composite the runtime derives is `<model>@preset/glm-claude-compat`.
